title: feat: plainer, easier-to-scan Home page
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Some visitors thought the site looked like a crypto project. This makes the Home page plainer and easier to scan.

- Prices Pollen in dollars: 1 Pollen = $1. No crypto-style wording.
- New page title and hero: "Open infrastructure for AI-natives."
- Models: one card per kind plus Community, with live counts and the newest models.
- Build: six equal cards, including the CLI and new Safety checks.
- Publish: each card links straight to its action.
- Removes "What we're building next" for now. Fixes clicks on the app carousel.

Preview: https://staging.pollinations.ai

gist.headline: A clearer path through the garden
gist.blurb: The Home page gets to the point: what Pollinations is, what you can build, and where to click. Even the app carousel knows where it’s going.
gist.summary: Reshapes the Home page around an “Open infrastructure for AI-natives” hero, model cards with live counts and newest models, six equal Build cards including the CLI and Safety checks, direct Publish links, and a clear 1 Pollen = $1 price.
gist.impact: Visitors get a faster read on the available models and tools, clearer paths to publishing, and working clicks in the app carousel.
